-- What a client importing `GooseLang.Ext.AbsDisk.Paths` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def Perennial.walCreateRegion (dir k : GoString) : Prop :=
  k = dir ∨ underDir dir k ∨ k = dir ++ go!".tmp" ∨ underDir (dir ++ go!".tmp") k

def Perennial.walAreaDir (r dir : GoString) : Prop :=
  ∃ n, walNameOk n ∧ dir = r ++ go!"/" ++ n

def Perennial.cleanAbsPath (p : GoString) : Prop :=
  ∃ cs, cs ≠ [] ∧ (∀ (c : GoString), c ∈ cs → pathElemOk c) ∧ p = (List.map (fun x => go!"/" ++ x) cs).flatten

def Perennial.pathElemOk (c : GoString) : Prop :=
  c ≠ [] ∧ ¬W8 47 ∈ c ∧ c ≠ go!"." ∧ c ≠ go!".."

def Perennial.walNameOk (n : GoString) : Prop :=
  n ≠ [] ∧ ¬W8 47 ∈ n ∧ ¬W8 46 ∈ n

def Perennial.underDir (r p : GoString) : Prop :=
  r ++ go!"/" <+: p
